text: Another captain washed in on the tide. {captain}, is it? Welcome to Brinehollow.
I keep the dock, the ledger and the peace, in that order. You'll be wanting to know the rules.
One: your ship is the only safe ground you've got out there. Die on some rock and you wake up aboard.
Two: anything you carry is only borrowed until it's stowed. Bank your haul at the ship's chest, or lose it where you fall.
Fall twice before you get it back? The sea keeps it. She always does.

choices.text: Where should I go after this?

text: Walk to the end of my dock and you'll board. Take the helm with F, steer with your keys, F again to let go.
She's no warship, but she floats. Mostly.
Tavern's to the west of the square. Gus pours, Nessa trades, and the Sergeant beats sense into folk in the yard past the tavern.
Lighthouse up on the east hill. The cove's south-east, and the old ruins sit deep in the jungle to the south-west.
People go into those ruins and come back quiet. Make of that what you will.
Ambrose up at the lighthouse watches the horizon all day. Ask him what's out there.
Or ask Gus. Every rumor on this sea ends up at his bar eventually.

bye.text: Mind the planks at the end. Third one bites.
